Specification: This module specifies the Fast Paxos consensus algorithm, modeling coordinators, acceptors, proposals, learning, retransmission, message loss, leader changes, and failure/repair of agents. The fault model includes arbitrary message loss except for the most recent message of a good agent, and arbitrary changes to the set of good agents and to coordinator leadership; progress is then stated under fairness assumptions and an eventual stable-goodness condition LA(c, Q). The specification defines both safety and progress aspects: safety through invariants such as type correctness, nontriviality, and consistency, and liveness through fairness constraints on good coordinators, good acceptors, and learning actions, together with a theorem that eventual stability implies eventual learning.

         /\ Quorum(i) \subseteq SUBSET Acceptor
         /\ \A j \in RNum : 
              /\ \A Q \in Quorum(i), R \in Quorum(j) : Q \cap R # {}
              /\ (j \in FastNum) => 
                   \A Q \in Quorum(i) : \A R1, R2 \in Quorum(j) : 
                     Q \cap R1 \cap R2 # {}
TheoremNames:
THEOREM /\ Spec 
        /\ \E Q \in SUBSET Acceptor :
               /\ \A i \in ClassicNum : Q \in Quorum(i)
               /\ \E c \in Coord : <>[]LA(c, Q)
        => <>(learned # {})
IfThenElse:
IF k = 0 THEN \/ v \in proposed
                    \/ /\ i \in FastNum
                       /\ v = any 
               ELSE IF Cardinality(V) = 1
                      THEN v \in V
                      ELSE IF \E w \in V : O4(w)
                              THEN v = CHOOSE w \in V : O4(w)
                              ELSE v \in proposed

IF cval[c] = none
     THEN [type |-> "phase1a", rnd |-> crnd[c]]
     ELSE [type |-> "phase2a", rnd |-> crnd[c], val |-> cval[c]]

IF vrnd[a] < rnd[a]
    THEN [type |-> "phase1b", rnd |-> rnd[a], vrnd |-> vrnd[a], 
            vval |-> vval[a], acc |-> a]
    ELSE [type |-> "phase2b", rnd |-> rnd[a], val |-> vval[a], 
            acc |-> a]
